dynamic-element.name: cardDescription
dynamic-element.dynamic-content: Java is a popular, high-level, object-oriented programming language designed for versatility and stability, making it an ideal starting point for new developers. Its core "Write Once, Run Anywhere" (WORA) philosophy allows code to run on any device with a Java Virtual Machine (JVM). As a developer, you will love that it is free to use and provides automatic memory management through Garbage Collection. It is widely used to build Android apps, backend web applications, and enterprise software. By learning Java, you also enter a huge community with countless resources available to help you troubleshoot and learn quickly.
